topics.description: Multiple sources report on a massive welfare fraud scheme in Minnesota, with estimates of $18 billion in losses. The scheme allegedly involved Somali individuals and led to calls for reparations from ICE.
topics.reason: Large financial loss and alleged involvement of government agencies

topics.description: The executive director of the Major League Baseball Players Association, Tony Clark, is resigning amid a federal investigation. The investigation's details are not yet clear, but it has led to Clark's departure.
